props.task: Drive DevOps cost/runner work, ship mobile chat infrastructure, and build the AI layer (MCP + Command Center) without conflating personal OSS projects.

props.markdown:
## How the streams fit

**WelTel job work** (AI, DevOps, mobile, platform) is employer impact — sourced from contribution reports under `weltelprojects/`.

**OpenCat Tunnel** is a **personal OSS** MCP platform (LangGraph, OAuth, plugins, portfolio bake). It is not WelTel product code.

**CatPortfolio** is this **agentic portfolio SPA**: Zod layout contract, matrix `meta.dag`, live `/ask`, and `?j=` baked resumes.

| --- | --- | --- |
| WelTel AI / DevOps / Mobile / Platform | Job | 42 tools · −30% AWS · 531+ mobile commits · SMS Axios |
| OpenCat Tunnel | Personal OSS | MCP gateway platform + agent runtime |
| CatPortfolio | Personal OSS | Matrix GenUI portfolio you are reading |
